dogecoin.text: In November 2024, President-elect Donald Trump appointed Elon Musk to lead the newly established “Department of Government Efficiency” (DOGE). This appointment, further elevated Dogecoin’s profile. https://t.co/Up3UpFCRtp

Elon Musk, has frequently expressed support for Dogecoin through social media, significantly influencing its market value. Tesla announced in December 2021 that it would accept Dogecoin as payment for certain merchandise. https://t.co/SRBX7bSqlX
